retrievalProfile.description: A classic 1960s album cover layout featuring a clean studio portrait offset by bold, mixed-style typography on a solid dark field.
triggerTerms: condensed white sans-serif on dark teal

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-quarter studio portrait of a smiling man in a suit, positioned on the right side of the frame, looking toward the viewer. The left side is a flat, dark teal-blue negative space used for large-scale, high-contrast typography in yellow and white.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed toward the viewer from the right third
High-contrast yellow slab-serif title against dark teal
Large-scale white condensed sans-serif for the primary name
Clean separation between photographic subject and graphic text field
coreInvariants: Asymmetrical balance with subject on the right
Mixed typography (slab serif and condensed sans-serif)
Studio lighting with soft shadows on the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right 40% of the frame, cropped at the chest, scaled to fill the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile serve as the primary emotional anchor, while the large white name acts as the structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves left to the yellow title, then down to the large white name, and finally to the tracklist in the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left 60% of the image is a solid, slightly textured dark teal field that provides a canvas for typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between text and background; low saturation on the background to allow the skin tones and yellow text to pop.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of geometric slab serif and ultra-condensed grotesque sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Title uses heavy slab serifs with consistent stroke weight
Name uses high-waisted, ultra-condensed vertical forms
All caps for primary and secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Large quotation marks surrounding the title in yellow
Tight letter spacing on the condensed name
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast pairing of a wide, yellow slab-serif with a tall, white condensed sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the slab-serif title style with heavy, blunt serifs.
Matches the ultra-condensed, high-impact sans-serif used for the name.
Suitable for the smaller tracklist and metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in a 1960s dark suit and white shirt, smiling, positioned on the right side of a dark teal-blue background. Ensure the left side remains empty and flat.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title in large yellow slab-serif uppercase with quotes at the top left. Below it, add the name in extra-large white ultra-condensed sans-serif, stacked. Add a small tracklist in yellow sans-serif at the bottom left.

verificationChecks: Is the subject on the right side?
Is the background a solid dark teal?
Are there two distinct font styles (slab and condensed)?
Is the name in white and the title in yellow?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (yellow can be swapped for orange or gold)
mustRedesign: Decca logo and specific catalog numbers
postGenerationChecks: Text is legible against the teal background
Subject does not overlap the primary text
The 'Stereo' banner is present in the top right corner
The color palette is limited to teal, yellow, white, and black
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait on right + Dark teal field on left + Yellow slab-serif title + White condensed sans-serif name = 1960s Album Aesthetic
